rationale: The candidate resolves my central conditions: advisory encoding-level claims, separate safety/definedness/feasibility judgments, explicit vacuity and solver outcomes, exact checked arithmetic, conditional pure synthesis, retained runtime authority and undiminished financial/PCD/Preview obligations. I request one small but substantive delivery correction before endorsement: A1 requires validated counterexample results while the validating replay mechanism appears only in later A2. The evidence interpretation also attributes fixed-bitwidth theories to Aeon without that fact being established in the supplied evidence.

blocking_changes.change: Include minimal pinned-evaluator counterexample replay in A1 before its functional acceptance. Keep enriched diagnostics, LSP and resource-use analysis in A2. Explicitly apply the replay-mismatch checker-error rule to A1.
blocking_changes.reason: A1 false-postcondition and definedness fixtures cannot earn counterexample-validated merely from a solver model. Waiting for A2 otherwise either blocks A1 acceptance or encourages weakening the status semantics.

blocking_changes.change: Replace the sentence attributing fixed-bitwidth theories to Aeon with a statement about the proposed finite-bitvector Moriarty encoding, unless separately pinned evidence establishes the Aeon attribution.
blocking_changes.reason: Decidability of fixed-bitvector multiplication is correct; the supplied Aeon evidence does not establish that its Int refinement encoding is that finite-bitvector theory.

retained_caveats: Finite fixture and mutation success cannot discharge encoding adequacy or compiler-to-ledger correspondence.
The exact treatment of hypothetical input assumptions remains conditional on authenticated runtime observations; feasibility alone does not authenticate them.
The numbered EARS topics must become actual shall requirements and positive/negative scenarios before implementation, as the candidate requires.
This is advisory design review, not independent validation of newly introduced test-count evidence, a Council runtime receipt, financial campaign admission or release acceptance.
changes_of_position: I accept the narrower initial literal/variable/checked-add-subtract/Boolean fragment and A0-before-A1 sequencing; it improves reviewability.
I accept conditional-later synthesis rather than NEXT as an unconditional delivery commitment.
I accept deferred diagnostic enrichment and narrowly targeted resource-use diagnostics, provided minimal counterexample replay remains part of the first checker increment.
I accept excluding an external Aeon proposer from the selected architecture, with reconsideration only through measured need and a reviewed scope amendment.
